items.text: the Texts panel has two tabs, Texts and Sequence, so the list of your words has room again on an iPad; play and stop stay above both
word sets in the Type drawer. Beside the word field, the set playing now (or “sets”) opens a list of your word sets; pick one to play it from its first word, or save the sequence as a set

the Words ring. Play or stop the word sequence from its first word, the next word, in order or shuffled, and your word sets, without opening the Type panel. Shift+W plays or stops it from the keyboard (or a remote)

water left on the floor after a drain (drops, pours, touch, ink) can be drained again: evaporate no longer says the floor is dry while it holds water; a little water evaporates in a little time; the floor can tip a part-filled pool off the edge
word sets. Save a word sequence (its words, order and timing) as a set beside the sequence's play button, and tap a set to play it again. Sets live with your palettes and scenes
the list of palettes in the color editor gives way: tap a color slot, a tool, save, Escape or the new “back to the colors” row and you are back to editing
an update puts you back where you were: the scene on stage, its playing word sequence, its sound and water come back after the reload
an older Current left open in another tab or app no longer wipes words, palettes or scenes you add here: this window puts them back at once and tells you to reload the old copy
two current windows saving at the same moment keep both saves, and neither keeps writing over the other
while Performing, tapping a button still tells you what it did ("palette saved" was hidden)
